How is CPF calculated for low wages under S$750?

Wages of S$50 or less: no CPF. Above S$50 to S$500: only the employer contributes. Above S$500 to S$750: the employer pays its rate on total wages, and the employee pays a factor (0.6 for age 55 and below) × (total wages − S$500). Source: https://www.cpf.gov.sg/content/dam/web/employer/employer-obligations/documents/CPFcontributionratesfrom1Jan2026.pdf

How is pay worked out for an incomplete month?

Monthly gross rate of pay × number of days actually worked in the month ÷ number of working days in that month. Example: S$4,800 × 12 ÷ 22 = S$2,618.18. Source: https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/monthly-and-daily-salary

When is final salary due when someone leaves?

If the employee resigns and serves notice, on the last day of employment. If they resign without notice, within 7 days after the last day. If dismissed or terminated by the employer, on the last day, or within 3 working days if that is not possible. Source: https://www.mom.gov.sg/employment-practices/salary/paying-salary
